sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Defeating the Divine Dragon triggers the next stage of game progression, causing some of the Mini-Bosses in Ashina Castle and Ashina Outskirts to be replaced by others as part of the final invasion.
- The first phase with the Old Dragons of the Tree is completely removed in the Divine Dragon's Reflection of Strength, and the battle will instead begin at the start of the second phase.

sections.heading: Phases
sections.text: This boss fight has 2 phases: Phase 1, Phase 2.
